# Catching Axolotls: All regions & months (including map)

[Update 05/08/2026] Map updated

[Update 04/08/2026] Weather control stations updated.

With Patch 60, a new feature will be introduced on June 3rd, 2025: Fishing. And there are rare axolotls to catch here every month. In this article you will find all available axolotls as well as a checklist (Plus/Prime User) and a map on which all regions in Appalachia, all water sources and even all areas where no camp can be built are shown.

## Axolotl change by month

The axolotls change every month, as you can see from the list. The change to the next Axolotl does not take place directly at midnight, but rather when the challenges are updated.

Change with the challenges on the **first weekly reset of the month at 6 p.m.**. So on the first Tuesday of the month at 6 p.m.
